title: Labcorp Announces 2026 Second Quarter Results; Raises Full Year 2026 Guidance
publisher: Labcorp Holdings Inc. via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: Second-quarter revenue was USD 3.731 billion, adjusted EPS was USD 4.99, and updated full-year adjusted-EPS guidance was USD 18.10-18.55.
summary: Labcorp's SEC-filed Q2 release reports 5.8% revenue growth, broad segment growth and margin expansion, lower quarterly free cash flow, debt retirement, raised revenue and adjusted-EPS guidance, and a larger repurchase authorization.
